hypothesis: Explicit visual evidence and bounded concrete query variants improve viewpoint-sensitive retrieval without erasing other constraints.
falsifier: No improvement on stress recall, wrong explicit viewpoint, or held-out regression above the frozen tolerance prevents promotion.
baseline: Frozen issue136 production responses plus live repeated smart-search calls; CPU lexical retrieval over identical pilot records.
candidate: Hosted Mistral Small 3.1 visual enrichment; local immutable BGE-M3 caption index; bounded full-query-preserving reformulations and reciprocal-rank fusion.
sample: 44 previously readable audit images and six historical report-only positive records, selected before generation. Failed assets stay explicit exclusions.
splits: Issue136 stress queries for diagnostics; six frozen historical test queries report-only, never prompt tuning. Preserve family IDs and original judgments. Sample-index results are not full-corpus results.

compute.orchestrator: Python 3 standard library on local CPU

gates: Inherit docs/quality-baseline-v1/protocol.json without relaxing unknown metrics. No switch or broad recaptioning without validated caption quality, full-corpus retrieval, traffic latency, cost, and rollback checks.
cost: Estimate from returned usage at 0.351 USD/M input and 0.555 USD/M output tokens; missing usage is unknown. Embedding billing reported separately. No zero-cost assumptions.
rollback: Candidate artifacts are separate and default-inactive. Production captions and both canonical indexes remain untouched.
